integrity: Exact symbolic rational checks are supplementary; infinite-dimensional sharpness follows analytically. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the real W^{2,1}(R^2) derivative-sum norm and planar rotations. Uses Ornstein endpoint non-inequality as an established external theorem; does not treat all coordinate maps or higher dimensions. The motivating new preprint was accessible only at abstract level; earlier general equivalence remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp rotation distortion of the planar endpoint second-jet Sobolev norm
